svg.title: The referenced document is out of reach
svg.desc: Connect a specific missing cell to a document beyond the boundary, terminating the retrieval route at the wall. The needed information visibly exists somewhere the run cannot reach. Visual distinction: A solid tiled network wall with disconnected cable ends. Indicates unavailable reach, not a decision awaiting human approval.
